description: This file defines the ActivationDataActivatorProvider class and its nested ActivationDataActivator class, which are responsible for providing and creating grain activation contexts within the Orleans runtime. It manages dependencies, creates activators, and handles grain instantiation logic.

classes.name: ActivationDataActivatorProvider
classes.description: Provides activation data for grains, implementing logic to retrieve or create grain activators based on grain type and context.

classes.name: ActivationDataActivator
classes.description: Creates and initializes grain contexts, handling grain instantiation and error logging.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerActivator
classes.description: Creates grain contexts for stateless worker grains, wrapping another activator.

methods.name: TryGet
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve an activator for a given grain type, returning true if successful.

methods.name: CreateContext
methods.description: Creates a new grain context for a given activation address, instantiating the grain.
